ddl:
CREATE TABLE apply_journal(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        relative_path TEXT NOT NULL,preimage_hash TEXT NOT NULL,target_hash TEXT NOT NULL,backup BLOB NOT NULL,
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('prepared','original_moved','replaced','verified','recovery_required','restored')),
        metadata TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(metadata)),FOREIGN KEY(project_id,proposal_id) REFERENCES proposal(project_id,id),
        UNIQUE(proposal_id,relative_path))

CREATE TABLE approval(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(target_type IN ('proposal','recovery')),target_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        preconditions_hash TEXT NOT NULL,capability_hash TEXT NOT NULL,approved_at REAL NOT NULL,expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
        consumed_at REAL,revoked_at REAL,FOREIGN KEY(project_id,proposal_id) REFERENCES proposal(project_id,id))

CREATE TABLE change_file (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,old_path TEXT,facet TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(facet IN ('staged','unstaged','untracked','selected')),before_hash TEXT,after_hash TEXT,payload BLOB,key_version INTEGER,line_map TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(line_map)),content_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(content_state IN ('read','excluded')),exclusion_reason TEXT,FOREIGN KEY(project_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES change_snapshot(project_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE,UNIQUE(snapshot_id,path,facet),CHECK((content_state='read' AND payload IS NOT NULL AND (before_hash IS NOT NULL OR after_hash IS NOT NULL)) OR (content_state='excluded' AND payload IS NULL)))

CREATE TABLE change_snapshot (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_project(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,head_oid TEXT,object_format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(object_format IN ('sha1','sha256')),index_hash TEXT NOT NULL,input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(scope)),captured_at TEXT NOT NULL,coverage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(coverage)),expires_at REAL,manifest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(manifest)),UNIQUE(project_id,id))

CREATE TABLE command_plan (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,executable TEXT NOT NULL,argv TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(argv)),cwd_relative TEXT NOT NULL,config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,env_allowlist TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(env_allowlist)),timeout_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,output_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,risk TEXT NOT NULL,plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL,payload BLOB NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(project_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES change_snapshot(project_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE comparison (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,before_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,after_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,proposal_id TEXT,before_run_id TEXT,after_run_id TEXT,payload BLOB NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(project_id,before_snapshot_id) REFERENCES change_snapshot(project_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(project_id,after_snapshot_id) REFERENCES change_snapshot(project_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(project_id,proposal_id) REFERENCES proposal(project_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(project_id,before_run_id) REFERENCES validation_run(project_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(project_id,after_run_id) REFERENCES validation_run(project_id,id),UNIQUE(project_id,id))

CREATE TABLE impact_analysis(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,payload BLOB NOT NULL,created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(project_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES change_snapshot(project_id,id))

CREATE TABLE local_operation (project_scope TEXT NOT NULL,operation TEXT NOT NULL,idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,result TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(result)),PRIMARY KEY(project_scope,operation,idempotency_key))

CREATE TABLE local_project (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,canonical_root TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,root_identity TEXT NOT NULL,git_dir TEXT NOT NULL,common_dir TEXT NOT NULL,metadata_grant TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(metadata_grant)),display_name TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=1))

CREATE TABLE local_usage_ledger (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES review_run(id),attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_no=1),
        provider TEXT NOT NULL,period_start TEXT NOT NULL,reserved_cost TEXT NOT NULL,actual_cost TEXT,
        estimate INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(estimate IN (0,1)),outcome_uncertain INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(outcome_uncertain IN (0,1)),
        settled_at REAL,UNIQUE(run_id,attempt_no))

CREATE TABLE notification (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,dedupe_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(dedupe_key)=64), count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(count>=1),created_at REAL NOT NULL, last_seen_at REAL NOT NULL, read_at REAL, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=1),FOREIGN KEY(project_id,event_id) REFERENCES workspace_event(project_id,id), UNIQUE(project_id,dedupe_key))

CREATE TABLE project_setting (project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_project(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(key IN ('recentLimit','editorId')),value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(value)),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=1),PRIMARY KEY(project_id,key))

CREATE TABLE proposal(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        review_run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,previous_proposal_id TEXT,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=1),
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','superseded','applying','applied','partial','recovery_required','restored')),
        payload BLOB NOT NULL,patch_hash TEXT NOT NULL,preconditions_hash TEXT NOT NULL,created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(project_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(project_id,review_run_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES review_run(project_id,id,snapshot_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(project_id,previous_proposal_id) REFERENCES proposal(project_id,id))

CREATE TABLE proposal_event(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,occurred_at REAL NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(project_id,proposal_id) REFERENCES proposal(project_id,id),UNIQUE(proposal_id,version))

CREATE TABLE review_attempt (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES review_run(id),attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_no=1),
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('running','succeeded','failed','cancelled','uncertain')),
        provider_request_id TEXT,usage TEXT CHECK(usage IS NULL OR json_valid(usage)),reserved_cost TEXT NOT NULL,
        started_at REAL NOT NULL,finished_at REAL,UNIQUE(run_id,attempt_no))

CREATE TABLE review_feedback (
        finding_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES review_finding(id),
        verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verdict IN ('valid','false_positive','uncertain','unverified')),
        note BLOB NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=1),updated_at REAL NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE review_finding (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,review_run_id TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES change_file(id),ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=0),payload BLOB NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(project_id,id),UNIQUE(review_run_id,ordinal),
        FOREIGN KEY(project_id,review_run_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES review_run(project_id,id,snapshot_id))

CREATE TABLE "review_run" (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL, consent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('review','refactor')), fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>=1),
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('queued','running','cancel_requested','succeeded','failed','cancelled','uncertain')),
        attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 1), budget_reserved TEXT NOT NULL,
        outcome_uncertain INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(outcome_uncertain IN (0,1)), result BLOB, error_code TEXT,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=1), created_at REAL NOT NULL, updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(project_id,id), UNIQUE(project_id,id,snapshot_id), UNIQUE(fingerprint,generation),
        FOREIGN KEY(project_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES change_snapshot(project_id,id),
        FOREIGN KEY(project_id,consent_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES transfer_consent(project_id,id,snapshot_id),
        CHECK((status='uncertain')=outcome_uncertain), CHECK((status='succeeded')=(result IS NOT NULL)))
CREATE TABLE schema_meta (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(version=7), applied_at TEXT NOT NULL, app_version TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE transfer_consent (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        manifest_hash TEXT NOT NULL, preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL, profile_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload BLOB NOT NULL, acknowledged_at REAL NOT NULL, expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(project_id,id), UNIQUE(project_id,id,snapshot_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(project_id,snapshot_id) REFERENCES change_snapshot(project_id,id))

CREATE TABLE validation_approval (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,confirmation_hash TEXT NOT NULL,capability_hash TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at REAL NOT NULL,consumed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(consumed IN (0,1)),FOREIGN KEY(project_id,plan_id) REFERENCES command_plan(project_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE validation_run (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('running','succeeded','failed','cancelled','timed_out','output_limit','interrupted','launch_failed','precondition_failed')),payload BLOB NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(project_id,plan_id) REFERENCES command_plan(project_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE,UNIQUE(project_id,id))

CREATE TABLE workspace_event (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(sequence>=1),project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_project(id),source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_type IN ('review','validation','proposal')), source_id TEXT NOT NULL,source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_revision>=1),type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('review.succeeded','review.failed','review.cancelled','review.uncertain','validation.succeeded','validation.failed','validation.cancelled','validation.timed_out','validation.output_limit','validation.interrupted','validation.launch_failed','validation.precondition_failed','proposal.applied','proposal.recovery_required','proposal.restored')),severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(severity IN ('info','warning','error')),cause_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(cause_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),occurred_at REAL NOT NULL, received_at REAL NOT NULL,target TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(target)), summary TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(summary)),UNIQUE(project_id,id), UNIQUE(project_id,source_type,source_id,source_revision,type))
CREATE INDEX ix_change_snapshot_project ON change_snapshot(project_id,captured_at,id)
CREATE INDEX ix_notification_created ON notification(created_at,id)
CREATE INDEX ix_notification_project ON notification(project_id,read_at,created_at,id)
CREATE INDEX ix_review_project ON review_run(project_id,created_at,id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_command_plan_project_id ON command_plan(project_id,id)
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_change_file BEFORE UPDATE ON change_file BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_INPUT'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_change_snapshot BEFORE UPDATE ON change_snapshot BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_INPUT'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_command_plan BEFORE UPDATE ON command_plan BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_INPUT'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_review_finding BEFORE UPDATE ON review_finding BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_RESULT'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_transfer_consent BEFORE UPDATE ON transfer_consent BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_INPUT'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_workspace_event BEFORE UPDATE ON workspace_event BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_EVENT'); END

CREATE TRIGGER review_finding_scope BEFORE INSERT ON review_finding
        WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM change_file WHERE id=NEW.file_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND snapshot_id=NEW.snapshot_id)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'CROSS_PROJECT'); END
